work.title: Untitled (Warplane with Targets)
work.description: Four shooting-range targets with numbered rings occupy the corners of a white ground, flanked by two iridescent compact discs positioned as eyes beneath a side-view warplane silhouette. Film-strip fragments and blue paint washes complete the composition, evoking a fragmented face or skull-like arrangement.
work.composition: Skull-like symmetry with warplane above CDs
